raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) has source_tz='UTC', while batches 1-13 are America/Chicago local time. Its txn_ts values start at 12:00, which is 06:00 Chicago, the same start as every other day. The 104 rows on 01-19 at 00:00-06:00 UTC are really the evening of 01-18 in Chicago. Normalizing UTC rows to Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January) in silver_transactions restores the volumes and the time distribution.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
